lines.en: What if truth is not invented, but discovered?
lines.zh: 如果真理不是被发明的，而是被发现的呢？

lines.en: What if every proof a machine checks becomes a coordinate: a fixed point, in a space that no one can see all at once?
lines.zh: 如果机器核验的每一个证明，都成为一个坐标——一个不动点，处在一个没有人能一眼看全的空间里？

lines.en: This is trureturing. True. Return. Turing.
lines.zh: 这就是 trureturing。真理 · 回返 · 图灵。

lines.en: An open experiment in giving machines a scientific method: to ask questions, test their own conjectures, and return what they verify to a library that only grows.
lines.zh: 一个开放的实验：给机器一套科学方法——提出问题，检验自己的猜想，再把验证过的东西交还给一座只增不减的图书馆。

lines.en: It begins with a philosophical bet. Truth is not created by the act of computing it.
lines.zh: 它始于一个哲学赌注：真理，不是被计算这一行为创造出来的。

lines.en: Call the whole network of truths, and all their logical relations, the Dao. Or God.
lines.zh: 把全部真理及其逻辑关系构成的那张网，称为“道”，或者“神”。

lines.en: A finite observer never sees that network whole. It discovers the connections, one at a time.
lines.zh: 有限的观察者永远看不到这张网的全貌，只能一条一条地发现其中的连接。

lines.en: And the project is careful to say: this is an orientation, not a theorem. It proves nothing about God, or the universe.
lines.zh: 项目也说得很清楚：这是一种方向，不是定理。它没有证明任何关于神或宇宙的事。

lines.en: So who is allowed to say what is true? Here, exactly one thing: code that passes the Lean four kernel.
lines.zh: 那么，谁有资格说什么是真的？在这里只有一样东西：通过 Lean 4 内核检验的代码。

lines.en: Not prose. Not intuition. Not a confident model. Declarations, proof terms, and their axiom closure. Nothing else carries truth.
lines.zh: 不是散文，不是直觉，也不是一个自信的模型。只有声明、证明项和它们的公理闭包承载真值。

lines.en: Today that is more than five thousand Lean files. Nearly a million lines. Almost thirty thousand theorems and lemmas.
lines.zh: 今天，这里有五千多个 Lean 文件，将近一百万行，接近三万条定理与引理。

lines.en: Any extra axiom must be declared in the open, or it is rejected.
lines.zh: 任何额外的公理都必须公开登记，否则一律拒收。

lines.en: Every verified result becomes a node in a directed acyclic graph of truth.
lines.zh: 每一个被验证的结果，都成为“真理有向无环图”上的一个节点。

lines.en: Once the kernel accepts it, the node is frozen. Permanently. It is never unfrozen. The graph can only grow.
lines.zh: 一旦内核接受，这个节点就被冻结。永久冻结，永不解冻。这张图只能生长。

lines.en: Each node is addressed by the hashes of everything beneath it. Change one pearl, and every reflection above it changes. Indra's net, rebuilt out of cryptography.
lines.zh: 每个节点都由它下方一切内容的哈希来寻址。动一颗珍珠，它之上所有的映像都随之改变——用密码学重建的因陀罗网。

lines.en: Nearly five thousand modules are already frozen. The only place where work happens is the frontier: the open edge, where no proof exists yet.
lines.zh: 已有近五千个模块被冻结。唯一有工作可做的地方是前沿：那条还没有证明存在的开放边界。

lines.en: One thread runs through the golden ratio.
lines.zh: 其中一条线索，贯穿黄金比例。

lines.en: Every natural number has exactly one way to be written as a sum of non-adjacent Fibonacci numbers. Forty-two is thirty-four, plus eight.
lines.zh: 每个自然数都恰好有一种方式，写成互不相邻的斐波那契数之和。42 = 34 + 8。

lines.en: Now replace each Fibonacci weight with a power of phi. Call the result beta of n. Does this new coordinate preserve addition?
lines.zh: 把每个斐波那契权重换成 φ 的幂，得到 β(n)。这个新坐标保持加法吗？

lines.en: Not quite. But the error is trapped. For every pair of natural numbers, forever, the deficit is minus one, zero, or one.
lines.zh: 并不完全。但误差被困住了：对任意一对自然数，永远，亏量只能是 −1、0 或 1。

lines.en: Three values. Proved for all inputs, not just the ones anyone happened to test.
lines.zh: 三个值。对所有输入成立，而不只是碰巧被测试过的那些。

lines.en: Machines can also kill conjectures.
lines.zh: 机器也能终结猜想。

lines.en: In twenty twelve, a closed formula was conjectured for the OEIS sequence A, one seven five, four oh six.
lines.zh: 2012 年，有人为 OEIS 数列 A175406 猜想了一个闭式公式。

lines.en: Then, at one particular sixteen-digit number, it is off by exactly one.
lines.zh: 然而在一个特定的十六位数上，它恰好差了 1。

lines.en: The refutation is not a numerical hunch. It is a Lean theorem, named result, whose type is: not claim. It rests on certified bounds for the logarithm of two.
lines.zh: 这个反驳不是数值直觉，而是一条 Lean 定理：名为 result，类型是“¬ claim”，建立在 log 2 的认证界之上。

lines.en: More than four hundred dossiers of published conjectures and questions are tracked this way, each with its sources and a literature check.
lines.zh: 四百多份已发表猜想与问题的卷宗按这种方式追踪，每一份都附有出处和文献核查。

lines.en: The deepest thread is about blindness: what observations cannot tell you.
lines.zh: 最深的一条线索关于“盲区”：观察告诉不了你的东西。

lines.en: Take two qubits. One pair is an entangled Bell state. The other is a plain classical coin flip, between zero zero and one one.
lines.zh: 取两个量子比特：一对处于纠缠的贝尔态；另一对只是经典地掷硬币，在 00 与 11 之间随机。

lines.en: Look at each qubit alone, and they are identical. Exactly the same local description. Yet the wholes are different.
lines.zh: 单独看每个量子比特，两者完全相同，局部描述一模一样。但整体不同。

lines.en: For finite systems, the theorem measures precisely what the local views omit: a hidden correlation sector, of dimension m squared minus one, times n squared minus one.
lines.zh: 对有限维系统，定理精确量出局部视角遗漏的部分：一个维数为 (m²−1)(n²−1) 的隐藏关联扇区。

lines.en: And one criterion ties it together: a target can be recovered from an observation exactly when the target is constant on every fiber, every set of states that look the same.
lines.zh: 一个判据把这一切串起来：目标能从观察中恢复，当且仅当它在每一条“纤维”——每一组看起来相同的状态——上都是常数。

lines.en: This is where the holography begins.
lines.zh: 全息，从这里开始。

lines.en: Imagine one history, seen through many windows. Each window shows only a part. Some of them overlap.
lines.zh: 想象同一段历史，透过许多扇窗去看。每扇窗只露出一部分，有些窗彼此重叠。

lines.en: Which windows, and which relations, are enough to reconstruct the whole? At what resolution? At what cost?
lines.zh: 哪些窗、哪些关系，足以重建整体？在什么分辨率下？代价是多少？

lines.en: In one finite model, adding a single inactive event leaves the present spatial snapshot untouched, yet makes a temporal composition illegal. A snapshot is not a history.
lines.zh: 在一个有限模型里，加入一个不活跃的事件，当前的空间快照纹丝不动，却让一次时间上的组合变得不合法。快照不等于历史。

lines.en: And the boundary is stated honestly: these are models of observation. Not a derivation of physical spacetime.
lines.zh: 边界也被诚实地写明：这些是观察的模型，不是对物理时空的推导。

lines.en: Every new theorem is asked four questions.
lines.zh: 每一条新定理，都要回答四个问题。

lines.en: Where did information escape? How was that escape handled? What new information emerged? And where does it keep escaping?
lines.zh: 信息从哪里逃逸？逃逸如何被处理？出现了什么新信息？它又在哪里继续逃逸？

lines.en: The judge is still under construction. Its aim is not to reward sounding smart, but to show which distinctions became visible, and which remain in the dark.
lines.zh: 这个判官仍在建设中。它不奖励“听起来聪明”，只标出哪些区分变得可见，哪些仍在黑暗里。

lines.en: So who decides what is true? Not a human. Not a confident model.
lines.zh: 那么，谁来决定什么是真的？不是人，也不是一个自信的模型。

lines.en: Proofs go to the kernel. Arguments go to adversarial reviewers from different model families. Every merge passes the same machine checks, whether it comes from a maintainer, a stranger, or an AI.
lines.zh: 证明交给内核；论证交给来自不同模型家族的对抗评审。每一次合并都要通过同样的机器检查——无论来自维护者、陌生人，还是 AI。

lines.en: Any gate that ends in 'awaiting human review' is treated as a bug. Humans choose directions, and authorize the irreversible. Machines judge right and wrong.
lines.zh: 任何以“等待人工审核”结束的门，都被视为 bug。人选择方向、授权不可逆的动作；对与错，由机器判定。

lines.en: At the center sit two open hearts.
lines.zh: 在中心，有两颗开放的心脏。

lines.en: One, O six, states Weil's positivity criterion: a classical doorway to the Riemann hypothesis. The statement is written. Its proof is not.
lines.zh: 一颗叫 O-6，写下了韦伊正性判据——通往黎曼猜想的一扇经典之门。陈述已经写好，证明还没有。

lines.en: The other, O five, has a proof body of a single deliberate word: sorry.
lines.zh: 另一颗叫 O-5，它的证明体只有一个刻意留下的词：sorry。

lines.en: The project says it plainly: it has not solved the Riemann hypothesis. What is not proved is marked open. Not hidden. Not faked.
lines.zh: 项目明白地说：它没有解决黎曼猜想。没有证明的，就标为 open。不隐藏，不伪造。

lines.en: Gödel proved that every consistent formal system strong enough for arithmetic leaves some truths unprovable. The repository can run unattended. Honesty cannot.
lines.zh: 哥德尔证明：任何足以表达算术的一致形式系统，都有无法证明的真命题。仓库可以无人值守，诚实不能。

lines.en: Primes never run out. Neither does the frontier.
lines.zh: 素数永远不会用尽，前沿也一样。

lines.en: This is a search for the primes of truth: irreducible, verified, fixed in place, one node at a time.
lines.zh: 这是一场对“真理素数”的搜寻：不可约，被验证，固定在原位，一次一个节点。

lines.en: The last line of the ledger is always the first line of the next round.
lines.zh: 账本的最后一行，永远是下一轮的第一行。

lines.en: And if thou gaze long into an abyss, the abyss will also gaze into thee.
lines.zh: 当你长久凝视深渊，深渊也在凝视你。
